list.name: Deploys
list.expr: max by (namespace, job, version) (aviso_build_info{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job"}) unless max by (namespace, job, version) (aviso_build_info{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job"} offset 1m)

panels.title: Scrape targets up
panels.description: Pods being scraped. 0 means metrics are dark, not necessarily the service.

panels.title: Pods by version
panels.description: More than one value means a rollout is in progress (or stuck).

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Total HTTP request throughput across all pods and routes.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered 5xx. Guarded against 0/0 so it reads 0 when idle.

panels.title: p99 latency (non-SSE)
panels.description: 99th percentile request duration across REST routes; SSE setup latency is excluded and charted separately.

panels.title: SSE connections active
panels.description: Currently open SSE streams across all pods.

panels.title: Request rate per pod
panels.description: Per-pod throughput. Uneven lines mean ingress/Service load-balancing is skewed (some pods idle while others saturate).

panels.title: p99 latency per pod (non-SSE)
panels.description: If latency rises evenly across pods while CPU is low, the bottleneck is downstream (backend), not the app.

panels.title: HTTP in flight by method
panels.description: Concurrent requests being processed. Rising in-flight with flat throughput = requests are stalling (usually on a backend).

panels.title: Backend operation latency p99
panels.description: Caller-observed NATS/JetStream latency. THE metric for the publish-throughput ceiling: if publish p99 climbs while app CPU is low, the backend is the limit.

panels.title: Backend operations by outcome
panels.description: Backend op rate split by outcome. subscribe is excluded (lazy stream).

panels.title: Backend error ratio
panels.description: Share of backend operations failing. Guarded against 0/0 when idle.

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: HTTP throughput per matched route pattern; route="unmatched" is 404 scan noise, route="error" is service-level failures.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered 5xx and 4xx. Guarded against 0/0 so it reads 0 when idle.

panels.title: Latency p99 by route (non-SSE)
panels.description: 99th percentile request duration per REST route and method.

panels.title: Requests by status code
panels.description: HTTP request throughput split by response status code.

panels.title: 4xx/5xx by route
panels.description: Client/server errors per route; includes auth rejections (401/403), unknown event types (400), and 5xx.

panels.title: SSE stream setup latency p99
panels.description: Time until SSE response headers are ready, NOT connection lifetime (see SSE connection duration).

panels.title: Notifications processed by stream
panels.description: Successfully stored notifications per configured stream.

panels.title: Notification failures
panels.description: Failed or rejected notifications; event_type="unknown" means the request failed before schema validation.

panels.title: SSE events delivered by stream
panels.description: Notification events only; heartbeats, control and close frames are excluded.

panels.title: SSE connections active
panels.description: Currently open SSE streams across all pods, by route and stream.

panels.title: Unique users with active SSE
panels.description: Distinct authenticated users currently holding at least one SSE connection.

panels.title: SSE connection duration
panels.description: Observed when connections CLOSE (30m window: closes are sparse). Long-lived open connections only show in the active gauge until they disconnect.

panels.title: SSE stream errors
panels.description: Error events emitted after the 200 response started; invisible to HTTP status metrics.

panels.title: Auth outcomes
panels.description: Authentication attempts by mode and outcome; service_unavailable means auth-o-tron is unreachable.

panels.title: ECPDS access decisions
panels.description: deny_destination retries are served from cache: decisions climb while upstream fetches stay flat.

panels.title: ECPDS upstream fetches
panels.description: Actual upstream call volume; coalesced waiters are not counted.

panels.title: ECPDS cache hit ratio

targets.expr: (sum(rate(aviso_ecpds_cache_hits_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min((sum(rate(aviso_ecpds_cache_hits_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(aviso_ecpds_cache_misses_total{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)), 1e-9)

panels.description: Share of ECPDS access checks served from the destination cache. Guarded against 0/0 when idle.

panels.title: ECPDS cache size
panels.description: Cached usernames per pod (each pod has its own cache).

panels.title: CPU per pod
panels.description: Cores used per pod (process collector).

panels.title: Resident memory per pod
panels.description: RSS per pod from the process collector.

panels.title: Open file descriptors per pod
panels.description: Each SSE connection holds an fd; sustained growth without matching active connections is a leak signal.

panels.title: HPA replicas (current / desired / max)
panels.description: Requires kube-state-metrics. current==max while desired>max means the HPA wants to scale further but is capped.

panels.title: CPU throttling ratio per pod
panels.description: Requires cAdvisor. >0 means the pod is hitting its CPU limit and being throttled (raise limits or scale).

panels.title: Memory working set vs limit
panels.description: Requires cAdvisor + kube-state-metrics. Approaching 1.0 risks OOMKill.
